Title: General availability: Zone-redundant SQL databases and elastic pools are now generally available in three additional regions

Body.Content:
Zone-redundant SQL single databases and elastic pools for Gen5 hardware platform are now generally available in three additional regions: UK South, East US and East US 2. The full list of supported regions includes:

  • France Central
  • Central US
  • West Europe
  • South-East Asia
  • UK South
  • East US
  • East US 2

The zone-redundant configuration is available to SQL databases and elastic pools in the Premium and Business Critical service tiers. For more details, see the blog post.
